claim: On neutral_hostile_v1/09_ml_artifacts, most promoted G04 one-pass verification wall time is owned by record() calls nested under node reconstruction; node logic excluding record calls and residual file/tree work are materially smaller owners.

decision.reason: record() calls account for 80.47% of measured one-pass policy verification wall time and occur entirely inside node reconstruction. Top-level node calls account for 88.01% inclusive, leaving only about 7.54 percentage points for node work beyond record(), while residual file/tree work accounts for 11.73%. There are 19 record misses and 96 cache hits across 115 record() calls, so the next discriminating measurement is miss-vs-hit time and miss cost by physical codec/geometry transform.
decision.scope_warning: Method timing is instrumentation overhead and is not product performance evidence. Fractions and owner ordering are used only to guide the next causal experiment; release thresholds and product code were unchanged.
decision.next_question: How much of record() wall time belongs to cache misses versus hits, and which physical codec plus geometry transform owns the miss time?
